subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:

text:

I hope this email find you well - I thought there's a good chance you'll be

conference Friday (6/13) to Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to
find a time that suits you!

subject: Encord & [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've recently started working with Target RWE, helping them customise a
multimodal dataset to train models that capture complex relationships
between patient attributes and disease variables. It's high-stakes - and I
imagine not far off from some of the challenges [COMPANY] tackles with scalable
ML infrastructure.

[SENDER] (formerly Browning) recently joined us at Encord and spoke
very highly of your work at [COMPANY] (She also wanted to pass on the hello to
Kalyan). Would you be open to a quick catch-up with [SENDER] and myself
sometime next week Mon/Tues after 2.30pm (PT)?

For context - we help AI teams from Target RWE, UiPath and AppFolio solve
scalability challenges for their MLOps pipeline. Our platform consolidates
data curation, annotation, workflow automation and model evaluation.

Let me know what works and I Look forward to connecting with you.

subject: Encord AI Exec Dinner - CVPR '25
text:
Morning [NAME],

Curious if you're going to CVPR this year. We're hosting a dinner and
fireside chat on Saturday (6/14) & would love for you to join!

subject: CVPR Connect if you're there?
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Hope you're doing well - I'm reaching out as I work with companies like Third Wave (Fox Robotics, Pickle Robots, Rapid Robotics) in the forklift and warehouse automation space to help scale annotation pipelines without increasing headcount, and improve model performance through higher-quality training data. 

I typically support CTOs and Heads of ML who are looking to streamline data pipeline efficiency -- especially when working with complex multimodal data across curation and annotation stages. 

Are you the right person to speak with about this? If not, would you mind pointing me in the right direction? 

Also, I thought there's a good chance you might be at CVPR this year. If so, I'd love to introduce myself in person as I've been following Third Wave for some time now.
